## Change

Describe the monitored behavior or evidence boundary being changed.

## Verification

- [ ] `PYTHONPATH=src python tools/release_check.py`
- [ ] deterministic synthetic fixture added or updated
- [ ] false-positive and false-negative impact documented
- [ ] no private target, credential, account content, or unverifiable real-time claim
- [ ] state and output compatibility addressed

## Claim boundary

State what this change proves and what remains outside the monitor's scope.
